question: True or false: an animated feature begun in the 1960s was taken from its director in 1992 and finished cheaply by others?
answer: True. Richard Williams worked on The Thief and the Cobbler for almost three decades. When he missed a deadline in 1992, Warner Bros. withdrew and the completion bond company, which had guaranteed delivery, fired him and his team. Its hired crew finished the film fast and cheap; Miramax later released it as Arabian Knight.
move: Whoever pays next weighs what is left to do, not what was done.
ask: When I take over something half done, do I weigh what is left or what was done?
trap: Assuming nearly thirty years already invested would buy him time to finish.
